object.description: Setup: paired strap, session recording; a screen recording or stopwatch is available. Steps: 1. Move the strap out of range or switch it off for 2 min. 2. Note the time of each Searching status shown on the Active screen. 3. Bring the strap back. Expected: The status changes to signal lost; the time between successive connection attempts (Searching statuses) is at most 30 s; after step 3 a bpm appears without user action.
